# Swift declarations that Periphery (scripts/lint.sh periphery, #6336) says nothing reaches, kept
# on purpose. One line each: the path from the repo's root, a colon, the name as Periphery gives
# it (or * for every declaration in a generated file), a space, then why it stays: a test that
# reads the source by name, a design token, a generated file, an entry point the system calls.
# Never an old finding to fix later: remove a dead declaration instead.
App/Sources/AgentsApp.swift: delegate @NSApplicationDelegateAdaptor: SwiftUI makes and calls the app delegate through it
App/Sources/Config/AgentConfiguration/AgentConfigurationView.swift: ownUnsaved read as the binding $ownUnsaved, which Periphery does not count
App/Sources/Config/AgentConfiguration/AgentConfigurationView.swift: leaving read as the binding $leaving, which Periphery does not count
App/Sources/Control/ConnectAnotherWanted.swift: current holds the ASWebAuthenticationSession while it runs; nothing else keeps it alive
App/Sources/Control/ControlSettingsModel.swift: link holds the ControlLink for the client while the model lives
App/Sources/Folders/FolderWindow.swift: columns read as the binding $columns, which Periphery does not count
App/Sources/Folders/ProjectSettingsSheet.swift: leaving read as the binding $leaving, which Periphery does not count
App/Sources/HangReporter.swift: monitor holds the event monitor's token; dropping it stops the monitor
App/Sources/HangReporter.swift: observers holds the notification observers' tokens; dropping them stops the observers
App/Sources/Hosts/MachineProcessesSection.swift: open read as the binding $open, which Periphery does not count
App/Sources/Notifications/PresenceReporter.swift: inputMonitor holds the input monitor while the reporter runs
App/Sources/Notifications/PresenceReporter.swift: sampler holds the sampling task while the reporter runs
App/Sources/Runtimes/RuntimesView.swift: showsOthers read as the binding $showsOthers, which Periphery does not count
App/Sources/Settings/SettingsWindow.swift: leaving read as the binding $leaving, which Periphery does not count
App/Sources/Sidebar/TerminalHostView.swift: SwiftTerm the file names SwiftTerm's TerminalView; Periphery says the import is unused
App/Sources/Sidebar/TerminalHostView.swift: colorScheme read by SwiftUI, so a change of appearance calls updateNSView again
App/Sources/WakeAndNetwork.swift: debugHook holds the observer's token while the app runs
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Client/ChatOpening.swift: isolation an #isolation parameter: the compiler reads it to run the call on the caller's actor
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Client/ResultCatching.swift: isolation an #isolation parameter: the compiler reads it to run the body on the caller's actor
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Model/MachineLock.swift: isolation an #isolation parameter: the compiler reads it to run the closure on the caller's actor
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Control/GitLending.swift: GitLend the type GitLendAsk.lends(in:) returns; Periphery misses it
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Control/Grant.swift: init(device:) passed as a function, map(ClientRecord.init(device:)), in ControlRecords.legacyDevices; Periphery misses it
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Control/Grant.swift: ControlEvent what PeerWire's case event(ControlEvent) carries; Periphery misses it
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Control/HostJoinFile.swift: iso8601 JSONEncoder.iso8601, read in HostJoinFile's encode; Periphery takes it for JSONDecoder's iso8601 beside it
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Model/EventWait.swift: deadlineMinutes read in EventWords' string interpolations, which Periphery does not count
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Model/EventWait.swift: cancelled(by:) a wire case: agentsd sends EventWaitEnding.cancelled and Swift decodes it
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Model/EventWait.swift: couldNotWake(reason:) a wire case: agentsd sends EventWaitEnding.couldNotWake and Swift decodes it
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Model/EventWait.swift: Canceller what the wire case cancelled(by:) carries
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Model/NeedRequest.swift: asker the label tells title(asker:) apart from the stored title; without it the callers in Shared/UI would read the property
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Model/Runtime.swift: npmGlobal(package:) a wire case of RuntimeInstall (Packages/Wire/schema/machines.schema.json) that Swift decodes
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Model/TimeHistory.swift: TimeSegment the element of TimeHistory.segments; Periphery misses it
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Remote/ControlAgreement.swift: description the error's message, which String(describing:) shows when the error is reported
Packages/AgentsKit/Tests/AgentsKitControlTests/Control/ControlRouterTests.swift: method a parameter of a ControlHandling requirement, which the test stub must take
Packages/AgentsKit/Tests/AgentsKitControlTests/Control/ControlRouterTests.swift: params a parameter of a ControlHandling requirement, which the test stub must take
Packages/AgentsKit/Tests/AgentsKitControlTests/Control/ControlRouterTests.swift: host a parameter of a ControlHandling requirement, which the test stub must take
Packages/AgentsKit/Sources/AgentsKitCore/Daemon/Capabilities.generated.swift: * generated by scripts/wire.sh gen from Packages/Wire: it names every capability, read in Swift or not
Remote/Sources/Panes/ShellKeys.swift: SwiftTerm the file names SwiftTerm's types; Periphery says the import is unused
Remote/Sources/Panes/TerminalPane.swift: SwiftTerm the file names SwiftTerm's TerminalView; Periphery says the import is unused
Remote/Sources/StartAgent/StartAgentView.swift: stopping VoiceModeButton's send closure type gives the signature
Shared/UI/Chat/SandboxFailureCard.swift: showsDetail read as the binding $showsDetail, which Periphery does not count
Shared/UI/LucideIcons.swift: * generated by scripts/design.sh icons; LucideIconsTests reads it

Shared/UI/Paper.swift: pill a design token (Paper.Radius.pill): design/tokens.json names it and DesignTokensTests reads it
Shared/UI/Paper.swift: sheet a design token (Paper.Shadow.sheet): design/tokens.json names it and DesignTokensTests reads it
Shared/UI/Paper.swift: Focus design tokens (Paper.Focus.width and gap): design/tokens.json names them and DesignTokensTests reads them
